title: iOS 1.5 — Move, duplicate and bulk-manage your flights
body:
- Move or duplicate a flight when the route or date changes — the flight's state and briefing history come with it
- Select several flights at once and delete them in one go
- A new What's New screen in the More menu, so each release explains itself
- The add and edit flight form now covers everything the web version does
- Help and feedback moved into the main menu, and Settings links straight through to your web preferences
- Optionally order upcoming flights soonest-first — Siri reads them back in the same order
- Better-calibrated turbulence advisories: clear-air turbulence now scales with altitude and stops at the top of the mixed layer, so low-level thermal bumps no longer read as CAT
- Sharper icing calls from the model's rain and snow content, and briefings re-run automatically when you change a flight's parameters
